blocks.label: Set Payload
blocks.description: Replace the message body with the result of a CEL expression.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: CEL expression. Sees body, vars, eventID, correlationID.

fields.name: rawBody
fields.label: Raw body
fields.description: Store the value as a raw-content body {contentType, rawData} instead of decoded JSON, so a connector (e.g. the HTTP source) serves it verbatim. The value expression must then evaluate to a string.

fields.name: contentType
fields.label: Content type
fields.description: MIME type recorded on the raw body, e.g. text/html or application/x-www-form-urlencoded. Required when Raw body is on.

blocks.label: Set Variable
blocks.description: Store the result of a CEL expression in a named variable.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Variable name to set.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: CEL expression evaluated and stored under the variable name.

blocks.label: Delete Variable
blocks.description: Remove a named variable from the message.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Variable name to remove.

blocks.label: Multi Transform
blocks.description: Apply an ordered list of additive CEL edits in one block. Each step sets the body (setBody) or a variable (setVar/value); the edits accumulate, so a later step sees the results of the earlier ones. Compresses a chain of set-payload / set-variable blocks into one.

fields.name: transforms
fields.label: Transforms
fields.description: Ordered list of edits. Each entry is either {setBody: <CEL>} to replace the body, or {setVar: <name>, value: <CEL>} to set a variable. Applied top to bottom; later expressions see body/vars produced by earlier steps. Expressions see body, vars, eventID, correlationID, env, now.

blocks.label: Template Resource
blocks.description: Render a declared template resource against the current message. Writes the rendered text to the message body by default, or to a variable when a target is set. The template is declared under resources.templates and embeds {{ CEL }} over body, vars, env, now.

fields.name: id
fields.label: Template
fields.description: The template to render: its resources.templates alias (the `as`), or its resource path when unaliased.

fields.name: target
fields.label: Target variable
fields.description: Variable to store the rendered text in. Leave empty to replace the message body.

fields.name: rawBody
fields.label: Raw body
fields.description: Write the rendered text as a raw-content body {contentType, rawData} instead of a plain string body, so a connector (e.g. the HTTP source) serves it verbatim. Applies to the body only, so leave Target variable empty.

fields.name: contentType
fields.label: Content type
fields.description: MIME type recorded on the raw body, e.g. text/html. Required when Raw body is on.

blocks.label: Log
blocks.description: Wire-tap that logs the message and passes it through unchanged.

fields.name: message
fields.label: Message
fields.description: CEL expression to log. Defaults to the JSON body.

fields.name: level
fields.label: Level
fields.description: Log level.

fields.name: logger
fields.label: Logger
fields.description: Optional named logger connector to write to.

fields.name: full
fields.label: Full message
fields.description: Attach the whole message (ids, vars, body) as structured log attributes.

blocks.label: REST Call
blocks.description: Make an HTTP request through an http-client connector.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the http-client connector to use.

fields.name: method
fields.label: Method
fields.description: HTTP method.

fields.name: path
fields.label: Path
fields.description: Path appended to the connector base URL.

fields.name: query
fields.label: Query
fields.description: Query params; each value is a CEL expression.

fields.name: headers
fields.label: Headers
fields.description: Request headers; each value is a CEL expression.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body
fields.description: CEL expression for the request body.

fields.name: failOnError
fields.label: Fail on error
fields.description: Turn a 400+ status into a flow error.

fields.name: statusVar
fields.label: Status variable
fields.description: Variable to store the response status code in.

blocks.label: SQL
blocks.description: Execute a SQL statement against a database connector.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the database connector to use.

fields.name: query
fields.label: Query
fields.description: SQL statement with placeholders.

fields.name: args
fields.label: Arguments
fields.description: CEL expressions bound to the statement placeholders.

fields.name: exec
fields.label: Exec mode
fields.description: Use ExecContext (no result set); result becomes {rowsAffected: N}.

fields.name: single
fields.label: Single row
fields.description: In query mode, unwrap the result to the first row object.

blocks.label: Flow Reference
blocks.description: Invoke another flow by name.

fields.name: flow
fields.label: Flow
fields.description: Name of the flow to invoke.

fields.name: oneWay
fields.label: One-way
fields.description: Fire-and-forget if true; otherwise wait and fold the result back in.

blocks.label: Handle Errors
blocks.description: Run the process chain; on error, expose vars.error and run the error chain (recovery).

fields.name: process
fields.label: Process
fields.description: The happy-path chain.

fields.name: error
fields.label: Error
fields.description: Runs when the process chain errors; reads vars.error.

blocks.label: Fork
blocks.description: Scatter the message across parallel branches, then join and pass through.

fields.name: branches
fields.label: Branches
fields.description: Parallel flows; each receives a clone of the message.

blocks.label: If
blocks.description: Conditional branching on a CEL boolean expression.

fields.name: condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.description: CEL boolean expression.

fields.name: then
fields.label: Then
fields.description: Flow run when the condition is true.

fields.name: else
fields.label: Else
fields.description: Flow run when the condition is false.

blocks.label: Switch
blocks.description: Multi-case routing; runs the first matching case or the default.

fields.name: cases
fields.label: Cases
fields.description: Ordered, condition-guarded flows (each has a CEL `when`).

fields.name: default
fields.label: Default
fields.description: Flow run when no case matches.

blocks.label: For Each
blocks.description: Sequentially iterate over an array, running the body per element.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Items
fields.description: CEL expression evaluating to the array to iterate.

fields.name: as
fields.label: As
fields.description: Variable name bound to each element.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body
fields.description: Flow run once per element.

blocks.label: Enrich
blocks.description: Run a body flow on an isolated copy of the message, then enrich the message from the result: a CEL expression for the body and a CEL expression per variable.

fields.name: setBody
fields.label: Set body
fields.description: CEL expression for the new body, evaluated against the scope's result (the enriched clone). Empty leaves the body unchanged.

fields.name: setVars
fields.label: Set variables
fields.description: Map of variable name to CEL expression, each evaluated against the scope's result and set on the message.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body
fields.description: Flow run once on an isolated clone of the message.

blocks.label: Validate
blocks.description: Filter block: assert a list of CEL rules against the message. If all hold, the message passes through; if any fail, the block rejects — running the onReject sub-flow (or a built-in response) and stopping the flow so the rest of the chain never runs. Failing rule messages are exposed as vars.validationErrors.

fields.name: rules
fields.label: Rules
fields.description: Assertions that must all evaluate true. Each entry is {expr: <CEL bool>, message: <text>}; the messages of any that fail are collected into vars.validationErrors. Expressions see body, vars, eventID, correlationID, env, now.

fields.name: rejectStatus
fields.label: Reject status
fields.description: HTTP status the built-in rejection response uses when a rule fails and no onReject flow is set. Defaults to 422.

fields.name: onReject
fields.label: On reject
fields.description: Optional sub-flow run when a rule fails, before the flow stops. It shapes the response itself (e.g. set-payload + set httpStatus) and can read vars.validationErrors. Empty uses the built-in default response.

blocks.label: AI Mapping
blocks.description: Reshape the message body to a target shape described by a prompt; validates against an optional output schema and errors on failure.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the LLM connector to use.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Instruction describing how to reshape the body.

fields.name: inputExample
fields.label: Input example
fields.description: Example input payload that guides recognition (JSON).

fields.name: outputExample
fields.label: Output example
fields.description: Example output payload that shapes the result (JSON).

fields.name: outputSchema
fields.label: Output schema
fields.description: JSON Schema the result is validated against; a failure errors the block.

fields.name: maxTokens
fields.label: Max tokens
fields.description: Response token cap for this call (0 = connector default).

blocks.label: AI Retry
blocks.description: Run the process chain; on error, let the LLM inspect vars.error, revise the message, and retry up to maxAttempts, then run the error chain.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the LLM connector that revises the message between attempts.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Instruction for repairing the message from vars.error before a retry.

fields.name: maxAttempts
fields.label: Max attempts
fields.description: How many times to revise and re-run the process chain.

fields.name: process
fields.label: Process
fields.description: The protected chain, re-run after each revision.

fields.name: error
fields.label: Error
fields.description: Runs when attempts are exhausted; reads vars.error.

blocks.label: AI Router
blocks.description: Route the message to a named branch the LLM chooses after inspecting it; the default path is the guardrail taken when it is not confident.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the LLM connector that picks the route.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Routing instruction; the model reads the body/variables before choosing.

fields.name: guardrail
fields.label: Guardrail
fields.description: Describes when to fall back to the default path (low confidence / ambiguity).

fields.name: routes
fields.label: Routes
fields.description: Named, described branches; the model picks one by name.

fields.name: default
fields.label: Default
fields.description: The guardrail path, run when the model is not confident.

blocks.label: AI Agent
blocks.description: Let the LLM call branches as tools in a loop to accomplish a task; tool runs share accumulating variables. The default path is the guardrail.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the LLM connector that drives the agent loop.

fields.name: prompt
fields.label: Prompt
fields.description: Task instruction; the model calls tools as needed, then stops.

fields.name: guardrail
fields.label: Guardrail
fields.description: Describes when to fall back to the default path (cannot complete with confidence).

fields.name: input
fields.label: Opening turn
fields.description: CEL expression for the agent's opening user turn. Empty hands the model the whole input body as a JSON document to work from, which is what an agent transforming a payload wants; a conversational one states its question here so the model answers it rather than replying in the shape it was handed.

fields.name: answer
fields.label: Answer format
fields.description: The shape the model is told to answer in. "json" suits an agent whose answer is the next block's body; "text" suits one whose answer a person reads and leaves the format to the prompt. The reply is parsed the same way either way.

fields.name: maxIterations
fields.label: Max iterations
fields.description: Cap on tool-calling turns before falling back to the guardrail.

fields.name: memoryThreadId
fields.label: Memory thread ID
fields.description: CEL expression for the conversation thread id. When set, the agent loads the thread's prior transcript before its run and saves it after; empty disables memory.

fields.name: memoryMaxTokens
fields.label: Memory max tokens
fields.description: Estimated-token budget for the stored transcript; it is compacted when it exceeds this.

fields.name: memoryCompaction
fields.label: Memory compaction
fields.description: How to shrink memory over budget: prune drops the oldest turns; summarize folds them into a running summary.

fields.name: tools
fields.label: Tools
fields.description: Named, described branches wired to the model as callable functions.

fields.name: skills
fields.label: Skills
fields.description: Named instruction resources the agent can load on demand. Each skill's name and description are shown to the model up front; it calls the implicit load_skill tool to pull the resource's full content into the conversation.

fields.name: default
fields.label: Default
fields.description: The guardrail path, run when the agent cannot complete the task.

blocks.label: Clear Agent Memory
blocks.description: Erase an ai-agent conversation thread's stored memory by its thread id.

fields.name: threadId
fields.label: Thread ID
fields.description: CEL expression for the thread id whose memory is cleared.

blocks.label: MCP Router
blocks.description: Turn a flow into a stateless MCP server behind an HTTP source: advertise tool flows as MCP tools, template resources as MCP resources and prompts, and route tools/call to the matching flow. Calls no LLM.

fields.name: serverName
fields.label: Server name
fields.description: Name reported in the MCP initialize response; defaults to the block name.

fields.name: tools
fields.label: Tools
fields.description: Flows exposed as MCP tools. A tools/call runs the matching flow with the call arguments as its body.

fields.name: resources
fields.label: Resources
fields.description: Template resources advertised as MCP resources and served on resources/read.

fields.name: prompts
fields.label: Prompts
fields.description: Template resources advertised as MCP prompts and rendered on prompts/get; the supplied arguments are exposed to the template as the body.

blocks.label: Cache
blocks.description: Memoize the body flow's result in the runtime store, keyed by a CEL expression.

fields.name: key
fields.label: Cache Key
fields.description: CEL expression evaluated to the cache key.

fields.name: ttl
fields.label: TTL
fields.description: How long an entry stays fresh (e.g. '5m'); '0' never expires.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body
fields.description: Flow whose result is cached and replayed on a hit.

blocks.label: Split
blocks.description: Split one message into many. Each element continues through the rest of the flow as its own invocation, so elements are processed concurrently and one failing element does not affect the others. The flow becomes asynchronous here: the buildResponse slot shapes what the caller gets back.

fields.name: mode
fields.label: Mode
fields.description: How the message is carved into elements. 'expression' evaluates a CEL collection; the others tokenize a text body one element at a time, which is what makes a large payload tractable.

fields.name: items
fields.label: Items
fields.description: CEL expression evaluating to the array to split.

fields.name: delimiter
fields.label: Delimiter
fields.description: Separator to cut the text body on.

fields.name: chunkSize
fields.label: Chunk size
fields.description: How many characters each element holds.

fields.name: onError
fields.label: On error
fields.description: What to do when an element cannot be dispatched: skip it, or fail the block. An element that fails once it is running always fails on its own.

fields.name: buildResponse
fields.label: Build response
fields.description: Flow that shapes the response to the caller, run once on the original message after every element has been dispatched. It sees vars.groupSize (the real total) and vars.groupId.

addressBranches.note: A block on the way to an address target must name a branch of this one: split[<branch>].<block>. Branches: buildResponse — e.g. split[buildResponse].<block>.

blocks.label: Aggregate
blocks.description: Combine many messages into one. Messages are grouped by a CEL expression and held until the group completes — by size, by timeout, or by a predicate — then the group continues through the rest of the flow as a single message. Pairs with split with no configuration.

fields.name: correlation
fields.label: Correlation
fields.description: CEL expression for which group a message belongs to. Defaults to the variable a split sets, which is what pairs the two with no configuration.

fields.name: strategy
fields.label: Strategy
fields.description: How messages are combined: collect bodies into an array, or fold through an expression (a running total, a merge, keep-latest).

fields.name: expression
fields.label: Expression
fields.description: CEL fold whose result becomes the new accumulator. It sees the group so far as vars.group (before this message) and the incoming body and vars.

fields.name: completionSize
fields.label: Completion size
fields.description: CEL expression for how many messages the group expects; the group completes when the count reaches it. An expression rather than a number so it can be dynamic — a constant batch size and 'however many this split produced' are the same field.

fields.name: completionTimeout
fields.label: Completion timeout
fields.description: How long a group may stay open (e.g. '5s'). The only condition that fires without a message arriving, so it is what bounds a group whose other conditions may never be met.

fields.name: completionExpression
fields.label: Completion expression
fields.description: CEL predicate checked after each message, over the incoming message and the group so far in vars.group (count, size, acc, ageMs, idleMs).

fields.name: timeoutFrom
fields.label: Timeout from
fields.description: Whether the timeout runs from the group's first message (a fixed window) or its last (a sliding idle window).

fields.name: storeKey
fields.label: Store key
fields.description: Identity the group state and leader election are namespaced by. Defaults to the block's own address; set it explicitly to keep in-flight groups alive across an edit that moves or renames the block.

fields.name: maxGroups
fields.label: Max groups
fields.description: How many groups may be open at once, so a high-cardinality correlation cannot grow without bound.

fields.name: onOverflow
fields.label: On overflow
fields.description: What to do at the cap: fail the message into the flow's error chain, release the oldest group early, or drop the message.

fields.name: buildResponse
fields.label: Build response
fields.description: Flow that shapes the response to the caller of the message just absorbed, run once per incoming message.

addressBranches.note: A block on the way to an address target must name a branch of this one: aggregate[<branch>].<block>. Branches: buildResponse — e.g. aggregate[buildResponse].<block>.

blocks.label: Invalidate Cache
blocks.description: Evict a cache-scope entry by its key so the next run recomputes.

fields.name: key
fields.label: Cache Key
fields.description: CEL expression evaluated to the cache key to evict.

blocks.label: Object Read
blocks.description: Read an object from the runtime store into the body or a variable. When the key is absent and `default` is set, the default is folded in exactly like a hit; otherwise the body is nulled (body mode) or the variable is left unset. Set `existsVar` to also record whether the key was found.

fields.name: key
fields.label: Key
fields.description: CEL expression evaluated to the object key.

fields.name: as
fields.label: As variable
fields.description: Variable to store the object under; empty replaces the body.

fields.name: default
fields.label: Default
fields.description: CEL expression evaluated when the key is absent; its result is folded in like a hit (into the variable, or the body). Empty leaves a miss as a null body / unset variable. Set existsVar to tell a default apart from a hit.

fields.name: existsVar
fields.label: Exists variable
fields.description: When set, names a variable the block writes a boolean into: true when the key was found, false when the default/null path was taken. Empty writes no variable (the legacy behavior).

blocks.label: Object Write
blocks.description: Write an object to the runtime store under a key.

fields.name: key
fields.label: Key
fields.description: CEL expression evaluated to the object key.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: CEL expression for the value to store; empty stores the whole body.

blocks.label: Object Delete
blocks.description: Delete an object from the runtime store by key.

fields.name: key
fields.label: Key
fields.description: CEL expression evaluated to the object key.

blocks.label: Queue Dispatch
blocks.description: Send the message to a platform queue subject to load balance work across replicas. By default it publishes fire-and-forget (one-way); enable Await reply to wait for one consumer's reply and fold it back in (request).

fields.name: subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: CEL expression for the queue subject to send to; enables per-message routing/sharding.

fields.name: awaitReply
fields.label: Await reply
fields.description: Wait for one consumer's reply and fold its body and variables back in (request). When false (the default) the message is published fire-and-forget (one-way).

fields.name: timeout
fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: How long to wait for a reply when Await reply is set (e.g. 30s); defaults to the queue service timeout.

blocks.label: Publish Event
blocks.description: Broadcast the current message to a platform topic subject, so every subscriber on that subject receives it (fire-and-forget fan-out). The message passes through unchanged.

fields.name: subject
fields.label: Subject
fields.description: CEL expression for the topic subject to broadcast to; enables per-message routing.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: CEL expression whose result becomes the published body. Empty publishes the whole current body.

blocks.label: Slack Send Message
blocks.description: Post a message to a Slack channel or user through a slack connector.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the slack connector to use.

fields.name: target
fields.label: Target
fields.description: CEL expression for the channel ID or user ID (Slack DMs a user).

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: CEL expression for the message text (required unless blocks is set).

fields.name: threadTs
fields.label: Thread timestamp
fields.description: CEL expression for a parent message ts, to reply in-thread.

fields.name: blocks
fields.label: Blocks
fields.description: CEL expression producing Block Kit blocks (a list).

fields.name: failOnError
fields.label: Fail on error
fields.description: Turn a Slack API error into a flow error.

blocks.label: Slack Verify Request
blocks.description: Verify an inbound Slack request signature and answer the URL-verification challenge.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the slack connector to use.

fields.name: signatureHeader
fields.label: Signature variable
fields.description: Variable holding Slack's request signature.

fields.name: timestampHeader
fields.label: Timestamp variable
fields.description: Variable holding Slack's request timestamp.

fields.name: rawBodyVar
fields.label: Raw body variable
fields.description: Variable holding the exact request body; must match the http source's rawBodyVar. Optional when the http source uses raw-content mode (rawBody: true) — the block then reads the raw body directly and re-parses it into body.

blocks.label: Notion Retrieve Page
blocks.description: Retrieve a Notion page object by id through a notion connector and store it in a variable.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the notion connector to use.

fields.name: page
fields.label: Page ID
fields.description: CEL expression for the page id to retrieve.

fields.name: resultVar
fields.label: Result variable
fields.description: Variable the retrieved page object is stored in.

fields.name: failOnError
fields.label: Fail on error
fields.description: Turn a Notion API error into a flow error.

blocks.label: Notion Query Data Source
blocks.description: Query a Notion data source (data_sources/{id}/query) with an optional filter and sorts, and store the response. Target it by data source id, or by database id (the block derives the data source).

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the notion connector to use.

fields.name: dataSource
fields.label: Data source ID
fields.description: CEL expression for the data source id to query. Set exactly one of dataSource or database.

fields.name: database
fields.label: Database ID
fields.description: CEL expression for a database id; the block retrieves the database and queries its first data source. Set exactly one of dataSource or database.

fields.name: filter
fields.label: Filter
fields.description: CEL expression producing a Notion filter object.

fields.name: sorts
fields.label: Sorts
fields.description: CEL expression producing a list of Notion sort objects.

fields.name: pageSize
fields.label: Page size
fields.description: Maximum number of results per call (Notion's own max is 100).

fields.name: resultVar
fields.label: Result variable
fields.description: Variable the query response is stored in.

fields.name: failOnError
fields.label: Fail on error
fields.description: Turn a Notion API error into a flow error.

blocks.label: Notion Retrieve Blocks
blocks.description: Retrieve a page's (or block's) child blocks (GET /blocks/{id}/children, paginated) as a {results: [...]} object, ready for Notion Page to Markdown.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the notion connector to use.

fields.name: block
fields.label: Block/Page ID
fields.description: CEL expression for the block or page id whose children to retrieve.

fields.name: resultVar
fields.label: Result variable
fields.description: When set, store the {results: [...]} object here and leave the body; when empty, replace the body with it.

fields.name: failOnError
fields.label: Fail on error
fields.description: Turn a Notion API error into a flow error.

blocks.label: Notion Page to Markdown
blocks.description: Render a Notion blocks array (as returned under results by the block-children endpoint) into markdown. Emits raw content, or stores the markdown in a variable.

fields.name: source
fields.label: Source
fields.description: CEL expression producing the blocks array to render.

fields.name: resultVar
fields.label: Result variable
fields.description: When set, store the markdown here and leave the body; when empty, replace the body with the markdown as raw content.

blocks.label: Notion Verify Request
blocks.description: Verify an inbound Notion webhook signature and capture the one-time subscription handshake token.

fields.name: connector
fields.label: Connector
fields.description: Name of the notion connector to use.

fields.name: signatureHeader
fields.label: Signature variable
fields.description: Variable holding Notion's request signature.

fields.name: rawBodyVar
fields.label: Raw body variable
fields.description: Variable holding the exact request body; must match the http source's rawBodyVar. Optional when the http source uses raw-content mode (rawBody: true) — the block then reads the raw body directly and re-parses it into body.

blocks.label: Notion Event
blocks.description: Normalize a verified Notion webhook and filter it by type and an optional predicate.

fields.name: eventTypes
fields.label: Event types
fields.description: Allowlist of event types (e.g. page.created, page.content_updated); empty allows all.

fields.name: filter
fields.label: Filter
fields.description: CEL predicate over the normalized body; drop the event when false.

blocks.label: JWT Validate
blocks.description: Filter: verify a bearer JWT against an OIDC provider. On failure it stops the flow with a configurable response (401 by default) so the rest of the chain never runs; on success it injects the verified claims into vars (claimsVar, default `jwt`) and the subject into vars.sub. Reads the token from a request-header variable — the http route source must copy that header into vars (source headers: [Authorization]).

fields.name: mode
fields.label: Key mode
fields.description: How signing keys are resolved: discover (OIDC discovery from issuer), jwks (fetch jwksUrl directly), or inline (publicKey / publicKeyResource).

fields.name: issuer
fields.label: Issuer
fields.description: Expected token issuer (iss). Required for discover mode (its discovery URL). For jwks/inline it is the expected iss, checked when set.

fields.name: audience
fields.label: Audience
fields.description: Expected token audience (aud). When empty the audience check is skipped.

fields.name: algorithms
fields.label: Algorithms
fields.description: Accepted signing algorithms, e.g. RS256. When empty go-oidc's defaults apply.

fields.name: jwksUrl
fields.label: JWKS URL
fields.description: JWKS endpoint for mode jwks (cached and refreshed).

fields.name: publicKey
fields.label: Public key (PEM)
fields.description: Literal PEM public key or certificate for mode inline. Set exactly one of publicKey / publicKeyResource.

fields.name: publicKeyResource
fields.label: Public key resource
fields.description: Resource id whose content is the PEM/JWK public key, for mode inline. Set exactly one of publicKey / publicKeyResource.

fields.name: tokenHeader
fields.label: Token variable
fields.description: Variable holding the bearer token; a `Bearer ` prefix is stripped. The http source must copy this header into vars.

fields.name: claimsVar
fields.label: Claims variable
fields.description: Variable the verified claims map is stored under on success (the subject is also set on vars.sub).

fields.name: rejectStatus
fields.label: Reject status

fields.name: disableWwwAuthenticate

fields.description: By default, when an issuer is configured, a rejection sets a WWW-Authenticate: Bearer challenge in vars (list "WWW-Authenticate" in the route source's responseHeaders to emit it). Check to opt out.

fields.name: filter

fields.description: Queue subject to subscribe to. Every replica subscribed to the same subject competes for messages, so each message is handled once across the cluster.

fields.description: Number of concurrent handler goroutines; defaults to the queue service default.

fields.description: How long a handler waits for its flow to finish (e.g. 30s); defaults to the queue service timeout.

fields.description: Topic subject to subscribe to. Every subscriber on the subject (including every replica) receives every message — broadcast fan-out, unlike a queue's competing consumers.
